bounty_h.Reward_Button_Hint: Left-click to hand in defeated bounty creatures. Right-click for information about bounty rewards.
bounty_h.Reroll_Hint: Reroll this week's bounty for @cost@ gold. This can be done once per week and changes the target for every player.
bounty_h.Reroll_Locked_Hint: Complete your first bounty contract and reach Novice Hunter rank to unlock rerolling.
bounty_h.Reroll_Used_Hint: The weekly bounty has already been rerolled.
bounty_h.Reroll_Info:
{Reroll Bounty}

Rerolling is unlocked at Novice Hunter rank. Its price decreases at higher ranks and becomes free for a Legendary Hunter. The reroll is shared by all players and can only be used once per week. It is no longer available after any player has defeated a bounty creature.
bounty_h.Reroll_Already_Used: This week's bounty has already been rerolled.
bounty_h.Reroll_Blocked: The bounty can no longer be rerolled because at least one player has already defeated a bounty creature this week.
bounty_h.Reroll_Locked: You must reach {~Gold}Novice Hunter{~} rank before Janice will allow you to reroll a bounty.

bounty_h.Token_Exchange_Title: Exchange one bounty token. Stored tokens: @balance@
bounty_h.Token_Profile_ACM: ACM Rewards - mostly Advanced Classes bonuses
bounty_h.Token_Profile_Training: Training and Knowledge - mostly primary skills, experience and spells
bounty_h.Token_No_Tokens: You do not have any stored bounty tokens to exchange.
bounty_h.Token_No_Hero: An active hero must be visiting this town to receive a bounty-token reward.
bounty_h.Token_Exchange_Failed: No valid reward could be generated. Your bounty token was not spent; please try again.
bounty_h.Ranks_Rules:
Only the first successful hand-in each week counts as a contract and awards tokens.
Bonuses listed are totals for each rank, not cumulative. Gold bonus applies to the creature-based amount.
Master / Legendary: +5 reward value can raise the base token award when a threshold is reached.
Rerolls affect all players, once per week, before any player defeats a bounty creature.

Bounty_Set.Modest_Info:
{Modest Contract}

Janice pays lower rewards for defeated bounty creatures. Bounty stacks receive the smallest additional Attack and Defense bonus.
Bounty_Set.Standard_Info:
{Standard Contract}

Janice pays the standard rewards for defeated bounty creatures. Bounty stacks receive a moderate additional Attack and Defense bonus.
Bounty_Set.Generous_Info:
{Generous Contract}

Janice pays higher rewards for defeated bounty creatures. Bounty stacks receive the largest additional Attack and Defense bonus.
